beats.subline: Tuesday, October 6, 2026 close — a record-setting day for the S&P 500 and Dow, with the Nasdaq extending its own record run from the day before.
beats.body: Constellation Energy led gainers after announcing a power-supply partnership with Google, and earnings beats from companies like Lamb Weston added momentum; easing Treasury yields also helped the S&P 500 clear its August record.

beats.headline: Rubio says Iran has 'lost complete control' of the Strait of Hormuz as Vance signals softer nuclear demands
beats.body: Speaking in Athens, Secretary of State Marco Rubio said oil shipping through the Strait of Hormuz has returned to near pre-conflict levels and that Iran's economy is in "total and complete freefall," while Vice President JD Vance said Tehran only needs to do something "meaningful" on enrichment — a softening from Trump's earlier demand for zero Iranian enrichment — as the two sides work to end their war.

beats.headline: Defense executives tell Taipei forum autonomous systems are key to faster wartime decisions
beats.body: At a Taipei defense forum Wednesday, industry executives argued that autonomous and AI-enabled systems are essential to shortening Taiwan's decision-making time in a crisis, part of a broader push — including a recent deal between Taiwan's state defense institute and Anduril on AI-enabled command-and-control software — to field asymmetric capabilities faster.

beats.headline: US military restricts troops on Okinawa to base after Marine arrested in woman's killing
beats.body: A 20-year-old Marine, Devin Jacob Ballard, was arrested after a 39-year-old woman was found strangled in a Naha hotel room; US forces on Okinawa paused operations and kept all troops on base for 48 hours, followed by a 30-day curfew and a review of liberty policies.

beats.headline: Northrop Grumman's YFQ-48A drone wingman completes first flight, fully autonomous from taxi to touchdown
beats.body: The Talon Blue prototype flew Oct. 3 at California's Mojave Air and Space Port with no pilot input for the entire sortie, becoming the third 'loyal wingman' contender — after General Atomics' and Anduril's Collaborative Combat Aircraft designs — to fly as the Air Force pursues a fleet of autonomous combat drones.

beats.headline: Anthropic expands Claude for Startups with a free year of Claude Team and $1,000 in API credits
beats.body: Announced Tuesday during SF Tech Week, the program gives eligible startups — those founded within five years or funded within two — a free year of Claude Team with up to five seats, $1,000 in API credits, and access to Anthropic's Claude Marketplace and Applied AI office hours.
